'''Carbo-plas''' or '''Carboplas''' was a lightweight material with a variety of uses, including the construction of barrels. Developed from a specific combination of [[Carbon/Legends|carbon]]-based [[Plastic/Legends|plastics]], when corrugated, it was used in the construction of the wings of the [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor/Legends|RZ-1 A-wing interceptor]].
